reason: Absence of a relevant candidate from a 20-item pooled ranking set does not establish absence of an answer from the 1,482-item corpus.

pooled_relevance.purpose: Judge ranking relevance within the fixed 20-candidate pool.

corpus_answerability.purpose: Judge corpus-level answerability only after independent review of a high-recall pool.

legacy_compatibility.rule: Legacy calibration rows are mapped in memory for audit compatibility and are never upgraded into corpus-answerability labels.

current_result_boundary: The reported 31.25% value is a pool-conditioned, model-assisted calibration false-accept diagnostic. It is not a corpus-level open-set false-accept rate.
holdout_impact: The holdout remains sealed and unexecuted. Corpus-answerability pooling for holdout is forbidden until the final method lock and one-shot runner exist.
